summary: Master compliance risk assessment and control testing with templates, testing plans, and reporting tools. Book practical 5-day training today.
lede: Compliance risk assessment and control testing helps professionals identify exposure, map controls and assess whether they operate as intended. For analysts, auditors, control specialists and risk officers, the course covers risk scoring, control walkthroughs, sampling and evidence-based testing. Learners also practice grading exceptions, tracking remediation and preparing management reports using digital evidence and monitoring workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with policies, controls, audits, or risk registers and need a more structured way to test and report compliance performance. Compliance Analysts responsible for risk registers and control evidence. Internal Control Specialists testing preventive and detective controls. Internal Auditors planning walkthroughs and control testing workpapers. Risk Officers prioritizing compliance exposures and remediation actions. Governance, Risk, and Compliance Analysts maintaining control libraries. Compliance Managers overseeing testing cycles and issue escalation. Operational Risk Coordinators tracking control exceptions and root causes. Process Owners validating controls in their own workflows. Audit and Assurance Leads preparing evidence for review. Third-Party Risk Specialists checking outsourced control obligations.
prerequisites: To get the most from this training, bring a basic understanding of your organization’s policies, process controls, or audit environment. A laptop and spreadsheet software are recommended, and it helps to have one sample process, policy, or control register available for the practical exercises.
